This one works too, and I can see the thinking. Tucking "Edit details" behind the "•••" menu keeps the card cleaner, and I imagine that little menu could hold other things later — like deleting one, or tucking it away. That's appealing.

The tradeoff I feel: it's one extra step and a bit less obvious than the plain "Edit" button. First time through I had to guess that the "•••" was where editing lived. So it's a wash between "cleaner card" and "instantly obvious."

Both get me to the same editing screen, which is what matters. Show me the third one and then I'll pick.
